capabilities.purpose: Compile the smallest authoritative context for an Intent.
Declare and protect the explicit change envelope.
Inspect and grow the Design System deliberately.
Evolve operational safeguards with measured exposure.
Evaluate maturity, complexity budget and fitness functions by domain.
Select an approved model route from risk, data, quality and cost evidence.
Record and reconcile model usage and cost.

selection_rule: Compose the smallest sufficient set for the Intent; do not create fixed agent departments.
